board.name: Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan (BSER), Ajmer
board.summary: The Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan, at Ajmer, conducts the Secondary (Class 10) examination, the Senior Secondary (Class 12) examination in Arts, Science and Commerce, and the Praveshika and Varishtha Upadhyay examinations in Sanskrit education. Its 2026-27 Class 10 syllabus sets Hindi, English, Science, Social Science and Mathematics as one paper of 3:15 hours each, worth 80 marks plus 20 sessional marks, and uses NCERT books for science and mathematics.

board_cards.name: Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan (BSER / RBSE), Ajmer
board_cards.classes: Secondary (Class 10), Senior Secondary (Class 12: Arts, Science, Commerce)
board_cards.note: BSER, at Ajmer, conducts the Secondary and the Senior Secondary examinations in Arts, Science and Commerce, along with Praveshika and Varishtha Upadhyay in Sanskrit education. Its 2026-27 Class 10 syllabus sets the main subjects as one 3:15-hour paper each, worth 80 marks plus 20 sessional marks, and uses NCERT books for science and mathematics.

board_cards.name: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
board_cards.classes: Classes 1–12; board examinations in Classes 10 and 12
board_cards.note: Our Jaipur page counts CBSE among four broad systems families there follow. Because RBSE Class 10 uses NCERT books for science and maths, a tutor may find the chapters familiar across both boards, but paper style and marking differ, so plan CBSE lessons from the current sample papers on cbseacademic.nic.in.

board_cards.name: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE)
board_cards.note: ICSE and ISC form another of the systems on our Jaipur page. Tutors used to RBSE or CBSE papers should allow for the council's broader syllabus in some subjects and its insistence on full working. List ICSE and ISC separately and keep cisce.org's specimen papers to hand.

board_cards.name: International Baccalaureate (IB)
board_cards.classes: Primary Years, Middle Years and Diploma Programmes
board_cards.note: A smaller group of Jaipur families follow the IB, our city page notes. The Diploma combines final exams with internal assessment, and maths comes as Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretation at Standard or Higher Level. A Rajasthan tutor with IB experience can teach it online beyond Jaipur.

board_cards.name: Cambridge IGCSE
board_cards.note: Our Jaipur page describes Cambridge IGCSE as exam craft: command words, the right tier and past papers marked against the official scheme. It sits with the IB in a smaller group there. Tutors who have prepared IGCSE students should name the subjects and tiers they know.

intro: Jaipur is the Rajasthan city with its own tuition-jobs page, divided into zones you can choose from. If you live in Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer, Bikaner or another town, join from here with your town named. Matching for home lessons looks at distance first, offering a family's request to the closest suitable tutors before widening, so the town and localities you list decide which requests can reach you. Online lessons run on a different basis: class, board and subject. A tutor in Bhilwara or Sikar can be shortlisted for a student anywhere in India.

Rajasthan students may follow the state board in Ajmer, CBSE or another board, and study in Hindi or English. Write each on your profile. The board's 2026-27 Class 10 syllabus, which uses NCERT books for science and maths, is on its own site and is a useful thing to know before a demo. Every request ends with a shortlist of two or three tutors, the family sees the fee you set, and the first class is a free demo. Senior Secondary tutors should name the stream, Arts, Science or Commerce, and their subjects.

towns.name: Jodhpur
towns.note: Jodhpur tutors register on this state page because our Rajasthan city page so far is Jaipur's. Type your colony exactly: home requests are offered to the closest tutor first and widen from there, and video lessons can still carry your profile to other states.

towns.name: Udaipur
towns.note: Udaipur tutors who teach in Hindi and English can mark which medium goes with each subject. A request often makes the student's medium clear, and matching on it spares both sides a demo that does not fit.

towns.name: Kota
towns.note: Kota tutors with senior physics, chemistry or maths can name the exact Class 11 and 12 subjects they teach and whether they cover JEE or NEET level problems. Mark online as well if you want students outside Kota.

towns.name: Ajmer
towns.note: Ajmer is where the Rajasthan board has its office. Tutors here who prepare Secondary or Senior Secondary students can draw on the board's syllabus documents, and those who teach Sanskrit education courses can list Praveshika or Varishtha Upadhyay separately.

towns.name: Bikaner
towns.note: Bikaner tutors choose their own fee and can vary it by level. Parents see the figure before booking a demo, so set it for the classes you actually teach; a clear figure up front avoids awkward talk after the first lesson.

towns.name: Alwar
towns.note: Alwar tutors should refresh their hours each time a slot fills. Requests are matched against the timetable on your profile, and an accurate one keeps you off shortlists you would only have to turn down.

towns.name: Bhilwara
towns.note: Bhilwara tutors who teach Hindi or Sanskrit can name the classes and say how they work on grammar and writing. BSER also runs Sanskrit education examinations, so mention Praveshika or Varishtha Upadhyay if you prepare students for them.

towns.name: Sikar
towns.note: Sikar tutors with Secondary board-year students can explain how they use the 3:15-hour paper format in timed practice. A family in its board year wants to see that plan, and a demo built on a real paper shows it.

towns.name: Bharatpur
towns.note: Bharatpur tutors should give the exact locality they live in before any wider travel list. Home requests move outward from the family's address, nearest tutor first, so a precise base is what puts your profile in front of nearby parents.

towns.name: Sri Ganganagar
towns.note: From Sri Ganganagar, online lessons let you teach students across Rajasthan and beyond while home lessons stay local. Mark both modes, give separate hours if needed, and agree a pattern with each parent during the demo.

towns.name: Pali
towns.note: Pali teachers who know the RBSE Class 10 pattern, 80 marks of paper and 20 sessional, can say so with the subjects concerned. A parent may ask how revision will follow the real paper, and the demo is the place to show it.

towns.name: Tonk
towns.note: Tonk tutors who have taught both RBSE and CBSE can list each board with its classes. The family's request names the board it follows, so covering both, where you genuinely have experience, widens the shortlists you can join.

towns.name: Jhunjhunu
towns.note: Jhunjhunu tutors new to private tuition can begin with a few subjects they know thoroughly. A family reads the whole profile before choosing a demo, and a focused, honest list is easier to trust than one that claims every class.

women.intro: Women who tutor in Rajasthan, in Jodhpur, Udaipur, Ajmer or a smaller town, can join NXTutors and keep their week in their own hands. Teach at students' homes, online or both; list just the colonies you are comfortable visiting; set hours that fit around home and work. Before a profile goes anywhere, the tutor confirms a phone or email with a one-time code and uploads a government photo ID that our team reviews, and real tutors who pass carry the Verified badge. The first lesson with each family is a demo where we ask a parent to be at home.
points: First, choose home, online or hybrid; you can change it later.
Then list the colonies you will visit, and only those.
Set the hours you want; parents read them before any demo.
At every first lesson, a parent is at home.
In a gated colony, the family can enter your visits in the gate register.
All talk of timings and fees goes through the parent.
At any point, you can stop classes and tell us on WhatsApp.

story: First, confirm your phone or email with a one-time code. Then add your Rajasthan town, the colonies you can reach, your medium and whether you teach online.
After that, upload a government photo ID from your dashboard. Our team checks it while the profile is pending, and the ID number cannot be used for any second account.
Once cleared, your profile carries the Verified badge, listing RBSE, CBSE or ICSE classes, subjects, medium and the fee you decided on for each lesson.
When a family near you asks for a tutor, they give class, board and subject. Two or three tutors are shortlisted, nearest first, then wider, then online.
At the demo, the family already knows your fee, and the lesson is free for them. Teach the chapter the student is on in school that week.
From then on, if they continue, you teach at home, online or both on days agreed with the parent, keeping your colonies and hours current.
faqs: What does the RBSE Class 10 paper look like?

For 2026-27 the board's syllabus sets Hindi, English, Science, Social Science and Mathematics as one paper each of 3:15 hours, 80 marks plus 20 sessional. Check rajeduboard.rajasthan.gov.in for anything newer before a demo.
I teach in Kota. Can I take online students?

Yes. Online requests are matched by class, board and subject, so where you live does not limit them. Home requests, by contrast, go to the closest suitable tutors first, so list the Kota localities you can reach.
How does a parent pick a tutor?
NXTutors shortlists two or three, nearest first, then zone, city and online. The parent sees each fee, books a free first class, and may switch tutor later without paying for the switch.

Yes. You confirm a phone number or email with a one-time code and upload a government photo ID, reviewed by our team before your profile is marked Verified. It is not a police check. See How we verify tutors.
Tutor plans are paid; /pricing shows what each plan includes. The fee you charge per lesson is your own decision.
Can a woman tutor in Rajasthan teach only online?

Yes. Online-only profiles are shortlisted on subject, class and board, not on location. If you later add home lessons, only the colonies you list are used, and every new family meets you first at a demo where we ask a parent to be at home.
Which boards come up for Rajasthan tutors?

Our Jaipur page lists four systems: CBSE, RBSE, ICSE and ISC, and a smaller IB and Cambridge IGCSE group. Name only the boards you have taught, with medium and classes; the family's request always states its board.
Can I teach some students at home and some online?

Yes. Tick both modes, give your home colonies, and add online hours if they differ. You can also teach one student both ways, perhaps home lessons on weekdays and an online session before tests, if the parent agrees at the demo.
